title: Go Atlarela ga Lefatshe
intro: Mo nakong ya diteko tse dikgolo, motho yo o tumileng o ne a newa letlotlo le legolo la lefatshe, e leng teko ya go leboga le go ikokobetsa. Leeto la motho yono le dira jaaka thuto e e tseneletseng ya gore dithoto tse di bonalang di feta ka bonako le ditlamorago tsa go itseela kwa godimo. Ribolola boitshupo jwa mowa ono o kgang ya one e gabilweng mo mmung o o ka fa tlase ga rona.
clues: Ke ne ke tshela mo gare ga batho ba ba neng ba kaelwa ke morongwa yo mogolo.
Allah o ne a nnaya dikhumo tse dintsi thata jaana mo e leng gore dinotlolo tsa matlotlo a me e ne e le morwalo o o bokete mo bathong ba le bantsi ba ba nonofileng.

Batho ba me, ka go itse khumo ya me, ba nkgakolola gore ke batle bonno jwa Morago ga Loso ka se Allah a se nneileng mme ke se ka ka lebala kabelo ya me ya lefatshe, le go dira molemo jaaka Allah a ntiretse molemo.
Ke ne ka bolela ka boikgogomoso gore khumo ya me e e seng kana ka sepe e ne ya fitlhelelwa fela ka kitso le maiteko a me, ke gana kamogelo epe ya bomodimo.
Fa ke ne ke kopiwa go ntsha moneelo kgotsa go amogela bopelotshweu jwa ga Allah, ke ne ka gana ka boikgogomoso, ke dumela gore dithoto tsa me e ne e le tsa me fela.
Ka ntlha ya boikgogomoso jwa me jo bo feteletseng le kgatelelo, Allah o ne a laela lefatshe gore le bulege le go kometsa nna le bonno jwa me.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go tshela botshelo jo boleele jwa poifomodimo
Tshenyego e e feletseng ka ntlha ya boikgogomoso
outcome.answer: Tshenyego e e feletseng ka ntlha ya boikgogomoso

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
